title: Generalisations of the Landau--Gonek Theorem and applications to mean values of zeta
summary: The Landau--Gonek Theorem evaluates $X^ρ$ summed over the non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function. Their result shows great sensitivity to the arithmetic nature of $X$. We prove a related result concerning the sum of $χ(ρ) X^ρ$ over the zeros of zeta, where $χ(s)$ is the term arising in the functional equation for the zeta function. Again, this result depends deeply on whether $X$ is an integer or not.
